_comment: Shadow/target branch-protection config for dev. ADR-0516 adds a temporary GitHub/GitHub Actions lane-unlocker; this file does not mutate live branch protection and does not claim P0.0 green.

required_status_checks._strict_rationale: Set to false per ADR-0124 to break the O(N^2) rebase cascade; the merge bridge enforces required status contexts without GitHub-side up-to-date enforcement.
required_status_checks._oya_pr_review_note: oya-pr-review is intentionally absent from Phase-1 required contexts. Its producer (reviewer-agent HTTP endpoint) returns HTTP 501 (not yet shipped); requiring it would deadlock every PR. Returns as required in Phase-2 once the reviewer-agent endpoint is live.
required_status_checks._phase0_target_note: Temporary GitHub/GitHub Actions lane-unlocker phase requires the automated github-lane-unlocker-required check so no manual oya-ci-required bridge is needed. P0.0/native cutover target remains oya-ci-required, posted by oya-ci-controller from trusted controller/trunk state after cloud-ci/cloud-scm proof.

_required_pull_request_reviews_rationale: GitHub human approving reviews are not merge authority for dev. oya-pr-review is future/non-live reviewer evidence only until its producer is live and explicitly required; keep this null so branch-protection re-application cannot recreate the hidden requiresApprovingReviews=true/count=0 blocker that stalls the next queue.
_phase0_p0_0_note: During ADR-0516 temporary GitHub/GitHub Actions lane-unlocker, live dev protection is converged to github-lane-unlocker-required to avoid manual oya-ci-required statuses. Destination authority remains oya-ci-required after trusted cloud-ci/oya-ci producer cutover.

temporary_github_lane_unlocker_bridge.cutover_condition: native SCM/CI/CD/cloud workspace/release conveyor seams prove their required context and operational contracts
